raw_segments.text: Lartius, O noble fellow, Who sensibly outdares his senseless sword, And when it bows, stand'st up!
Thou art left, Martius. A carbuncle entire, as big as thou art, Were not so rich a jewel.
Thou wast a soldier Even to Cato's wish, not fierce and terrible Only in strokes, but with thy grim looks
And the thunderlike percussion of thy sounds Thou mad'st thine enemies shake, as if the world Were feverous and did tremble.
